passages.text: Don’t be afraid of their imaginations against you, don’t let the unbelief of them that speak against you trouble you.

Be you⌃ not afraid, neither doubt; for God is your guide: and you⌃ who keep my commandments and precepts, says the Lord God, don’t let your sins weigh you down, and don’t let your iniquities lift up themselves.
passages.note: fear, doubt, and guilt weighing one down
